# DropSpace v0.3.1-beta.6

<!-- update-summary: 修复酷狗有歌词却被误过滤：保留同一歌曲已核实的时长，第一条歌曲记录没有可用歌词时继续查找；本次按用户要求跳过功能测试。 -->

## 修复内容

- 修复《风的来信》等歌曲能在酷狗找到、App 却加载失败的问题：歌词记录未填写整曲时长时，沿用同一歌曲哈希绑定且标题、歌手一致的已核实目录时长。歌词正文的逐句时间戳原本存在，没有修改或编造。
- 歌曲搜索的第一条匹配记录没有可用歌词或取词失败时，继续尝试后面的有效记录；避免反复请求同一哈希。目录和歌词尝试均有上限。
- 继续拒绝标题、歌手、版本或已填写时长冲突的结果；不会为了找出歌词而接受不相关歌曲。

## Verification boundaries

Actual provider investigation retrieved 52 timestamped lines from both Kugou and QQ;
the beta5 parser read them successfully. Before the fix, a real-metadata scoring harness
reproduced catalog score 11.7 versus lyric-record score 0 because duration was omitted.
Two new regressions failed before correction. After that run, the owner explicitly waived
all further functional tests and acceptance checks for this emergency release.
Post-fix tests, installer lifecycle and both-language startup acceptance are therefore
NOT claimed. Compilation, package production and immutable artifact identity bindings remain.
The exception is limited to v0.3.1-beta.6. Model quality, GPU and real-device acceptance remain unchanged.
NetEase/QQ search availability is provider/network-dependent and is not claimed repaired.

## Compatibility

Semantic version: 0.3.1-beta.6. PE/MSIX version: 0.3.1.6. v0.3.1-beta.5 is the immediate upgrade baseline. Stable remains v0.2.1. Existing models, settings and data are retained.
